subject.title: fix(build): add explicit ESM format to nodeBuildConfig for type module package

question: Should maintainers merge this defensive ESM build pin as cleanup, and if so how should the commit-level closing metadata for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91539 be handled?
rationale: The code change is mechanically safe, but it is not the proven root-cause fix and the remaining risk is merge/issue-state handling rather than a line-level defect automation can resolve with confidence.

options.title: Merge As Cleanup With Neutral Metadata
options.body: Squash or otherwise rewrite the merge metadata so the canonical regression is not closed by this cleanup-only PR.

options.title: Merge And Manually Guard The Issue
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally merge the pin and verify the canonical issue remains open or is corrected immediately afterward.

options.title: Close This Cleanup PR
options.body: If a no-op defensive pin is not worth carrying, close this PR and leave the remaining document-extract work on the canonical issue and merged inspect fix.

recommendation.title: Merge As Cleanup With Neutral Metadata
recommendation.body: Squash or otherwise rewrite the merge metadata so the canonical regression is not closed by this cleanup-only PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across both the build config and plugin inspect surfaces and is the strongest routing candidate for the merge-policy choice.
